Workspace, theme and components

Stable Doppio Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: uikit/theme.rs

How the Rust Doppio workspace is composed: the PaneGrid layout, the Iced component kit, the visual tokens, and where the legacy C++ UI kit still applies.

Two UI stacks, one product#

StackUsed byLocation
Rust / Iced The active Doppio editor: docking, hierarchy, viewport, inspector, assets, console and generators. doppio/crates/ui/
C++ / ImGui UIKit The standalone runtime, legacy plugins and archived C++ Doppio panels. include/caffeine/ui/

The stacks share design vocabulary, not code. Do not describe the Rust editor as using Caffeine::UIKit; the C++ kit is only loaded by the runtime and plugins.

Window → panel → component#

Layer Location Rule
Window windows/main.rs Owns App, messages, subscriptions and the PaneGrid.
Panel uikit/panels/*.rs Pure view(...) -> Element; never calls raw text_input, checkbox, slider or button.
Component uikit/components/*.rs Reusable primitives: buttons, fields, cards, tabs, menus, tree view, gizmo, viewport surface, node canvas.

Panels compose components. scripts/check-rust-ui.sh rejects raw widgets in uikit/panels/, which keeps focus, hover, disabled states and theme consistent.

Layout and docking#

The default PaneGrid is built from four regions:

  1. Hierarchy on the left.
  2. A centre group with Viewport, Material Generator, Texture Generator, Texture Set, Script and Dryad Nodes.
  3. A right group with Inspector, Material, Nature, Water and Terrain.
  4. A bottom group with Assets and Console.

Drag a tab by its header to show docking guides: the centre adds it to the target pane, an edge splits the pane. Pane buttons maximise and restore. Layout presets are in the View menu:

Preset Shortcut Result
Default Layout Ctrl+1 Hierarchy left, centre/right tools, Assets + Console bottom
Viewport Layout Ctrl+2 Gives the viewport most of the window

The Rust layout is session state; it is not written to workspace.json. The legacy ImGui Caffeine::Workspace still persists ~/.config/caffeine/ui/workspace.json for the runtime and plugin hosts.

Theme tokens#

doppio/crates/ui/src/uikit/theme.rs is the only source of colours, borders and spacing. Panels must not hardcode colours.

TokenValueUsed for
BACKGROUND#151515Window and viewport surround
PANEL#242424Pane bodies and cards
PANEL_ALT#2e2e2eAlternating rows and inputs
TOOLBAR#1e1e1eTab bars, menus and status bar
BORDER#313131Panel and field outlines
TEXT#d6d6d6Primary labels and values
TEXT_MUTED#8e8e8eSecondary labels and hints
ACCENT#4a8fe0Selection, focus and active tools
DANGER#c24f4fDelete, errors and destructive actions
WARNING#d1a03cWarnings and pending states
SUCCESS#5da56bSaved state and successful checks

Generator identity bars use the icon palette: cyan for Material, orange for Texture and Terrain, green for Nature, cyan-blue for Water.

Stable widget ids#

Every interactive widget has a hierarchical UiId (editor.menu.scene, inspector.entity.name, hierarchy.list.entity_row.3) and an entry in uikit::id::CATALOG with kind and description. The catalogue drives:

  • headless targeting and annotated screenshots;
  • the generated UI reference;
  • agent actions and the docs captions in captures/ui-captions.json.

Add an id and a catalogue entry with every new widget.

Legacy C++ kit (runtime and plugins)#

include/caffeine/ui/ still provides Theme, Widgets, Icons, PanelRegistry and Workspace for caffeine-runtime and C++ plugins. It is immediate-mode ImGui, not Iced. Plugin panels use caffeine/plugin/PluginUI.hpp and the same PanelRegistry ids; their layout is persisted by Workspace in ~/.config/caffeine/ui/workspace.json.

Note. The archived C++ editor under doppio-archived/ also used this kit. It is frozen reference code and is not part of the active editor.
